description.value: Kwinitsa Station Museum is a historic Canadian National Railway station building that was relocated to Prince Rupert's waterfront, preserved as a snapshot of the region's railway-building era. It is administered by the Museum of Northern British Columbia, which stewards the natural and cultural heritage of the Northwest Coast. For touring cyclists arriving by ferry or passing through Prince Rupert, it offers a compact, walkable piece of local industrial history near the waterfront.

enrichment_extras.notes: The Kwinitsa Station Museum is a satellite site of the Museum of Northern BC. Visitors and cyclists seeking current hours or access details should contact the main museum at 250 624 3207 or visit museumofnorthernbc.com directly.
